description: Source code for the GoogleKeepConverter class, which converts Google Keep backup files into note objects, supporting JSON and HTML parsing.

classes.name: GoogleKeepConverter
classes.description: A class that provides methods to parse Google Keep backup files into note data, supporting JSON and HTML formats.

methods.name: convertGoogleKeepBackupFileToNote
methods.description: Asynchronously converts a Google Keep backup file into a note payload, trying JSON first, then HTML parsing.

methods.name: tryParseAsHtml
methods.description: Parses HTML content from a Google Keep note, extracting title and content, optionally stripping HTML tags.

methods.name: getDateFromGKeepNote
methods.description: Extracts and returns the date from a Google Keep note string, if available.

methods.name: isValidGoogleKeepJson
methods.description: Static method to validate if a JSON object conforms to the expected Google Keep note structure.

methods.name: tryParseAsJson
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string as JSON into a Google Keep note payload, validating structure and extracting date.
